frontmatter.title: Valkey vs Redis Technical Comparison
frontmatter.description: In modern distributed systems and caching applications, the choice of a data storage solution is critical to system performance and stability. This article provides a comparative analysis of two commonly used data storage solutions — Redis and ValkeyDB (referred to as Valkey) — focusing on their technical specifications. The goal is to help developers understand their respective advantages and suitable scenarios.
